3d0bbbfe98af81b5c941.en: Your body has many parts. Each part helps you do something.
3d0bbbfe98af81b5c941.id: Tubuhmu punya banyak bagian. Setiap bagian membantumu melakukan sesuatu.

c95408866c2320da9f9b.en: Your head has your eyes, ears, nose and mouth.
c95408866c2320da9f9b.id: Di kepalamu (head) ada mata, telinga, hidung, dan mulut.

d28b836aab03f82c2623.en: Your arm bends at the elbow. Your hands hold things.
d28b836aab03f82c2623.id: Lenganmu (arm) menekuk di siku (elbow). Tanganmu (hand) memegang benda.

e67385e3456d127d85d2.en: Your leg bends at the knee. Your feet help you walk.
e67385e3456d127d85d2.id: Kakimu (leg) menekuk di lutut (knee). Telapak kakimu (feet) membantumu berjalan.

43ff09eb51d89a6ad46b.en: Some parts are inside you. Your heart beats in your chest.
43ff09eb51d89a6ad46b.id: Ada bagian yang berada di dalam tubuhmu. Jantungmu berdetak di dalam dada.

eafb14c22c596c9fb69f.en: Your leg bends at the knee. Your arm bends at the elbow.
eafb14c22c596c9fb69f.id: Kakimu menekuk di lutut (knee). Lenganmu menekuk di siku (elbow).

e9aae99de4013ae70268.en: We hold a cup with our hand. Our fingers wrap around it.
e9aae99de4013ae70268.id: Kita memegang cangkir dengan tangan (hand). Jari-jari kita melingkari cangkir itu.

81f0c3cc48e8e823fbba.en: We use our legs and feet to walk, run and jump.
81f0c3cc48e8e823fbba.id: Kita memakai kaki (legs) dan telapak kaki (feet) untuk berjalan, berlari, dan melompat.

a7696707f3dbe48aa3b8.en: Teeth chew food, legs help us walk and run, hands hold things and the neck lets us turn our head.
a7696707f3dbe48aa3b8.id: Gigi (teeth) mengunyah makanan, kaki (legs) membantu kita berjalan dan berlari, tangan (hands) memegang benda, dan leher (neck) membuat kita bisa menoleh.

9f6670113ee36330651a.en: Most people have 2 eyes, one on each side of the nose.
9f6670113ee36330651a.id: Kebanyakan orang punya 2 mata, satu di setiap sisi hidung.

6ae586de4675b5ead09c.en: The elbow is in the middle of the arm, between the shoulder and the hand. It lets the arm bend.
6ae586de4675b5ead09c.id: Siku (elbow) ada di tengah lengan, di antara bahu dan tangan. Siku membuat lengan bisa menekuk.

75c30db32998b1d8af30.en: The knee is in the middle of the leg. It lets the leg bend when we sit, kick or climb.
75c30db32998b1d8af30.id: Lutut (knee) ada di tengah kaki. Lutut membuat kaki bisa menekuk saat kita duduk, menendang, atau memanjat.

eb3ff199e61249dac639.en: The elbow, wrist and fingers are on the arm and hand. The knee, ankle and toes are on the leg and foot.
eb3ff199e61249dac639.id: Siku (elbow), pergelangan tangan (wrist), dan jari tangan (fingers) ada di lengan dan tangan. Lutut (knee), pergelangan kaki (ankle), dan jari kaki (toes) ada di kaki dan telapak kaki.

cd5442d83402cff42ff0.en: We chew food with our teeth. Brushing them keeps them clean and strong.
cd5442d83402cff42ff0.id: Kita mengunyah makanan dengan gigi (teeth). Menyikat gigi membuat gigi tetap bersih dan kuat.

dc751d625f4e1a140d15.en: A watch is worn on the wrist. The wrist joins the hand to the arm.
dc751d625f4e1a140d15.id: Jam tangan dipakai di pergelangan tangan (wrist). Pergelangan tangan menghubungkan tangan dengan lengan.

6032d5250a502b3d65c1.en: Eyes, ears and arms come in pairs, one on each side of the body. The nose and mouth are in the middle, and there is one of each.
6032d5250a502b3d65c1.id: Mata (eyes), telinga (ears), dan lengan (arms) ada sepasang, satu di setiap sisi tubuh. Hidung (nose) dan mulut (mouth) ada di tengah, dan jumlahnya masing-masing satu.

e2b3f673b52bc80d1734.en: From top to bottom, the order is head, neck, shoulders, knees, ankles and toes.
e2b3f673b52bc80d1734.id: Dari atas ke bawah, urutannya adalah kepala (head), leher (neck), bahu (shoulders), lutut (knees), pergelangan kaki (ankles), dan jari kaki (toes).

5d0505a0c88e52d543fd.en: The tongue helps us taste food, move it around while we chew and make sounds when we talk.
5d0505a0c88e52d543fd.id: Lidah (tongue) membantu kita mengecap rasa makanan, menggerakkan makanan saat mengunyah, dan mengeluarkan bunyi saat berbicara.

69b56c5ed7952a89c802.en: The heart is inside the chest. We cannot see it, but we can feel it beating. The elbow and the chin are on the outside.
69b56c5ed7952a89c802.id: Jantung (heart) ada di dalam dada. Kita tidak bisa melihatnya, tetapi kita bisa merasakan detaknya. Siku (elbow) dan dagu (chin) ada di luar tubuh.

4ac67e20063f71d2cf6a.en: The elbow, the knee and the wrist are joints. Joints are places where the body bends. The nose and the chin do not bend.
4ac67e20063f71d2cf6a.id: Siku (elbow), lutut (knee), dan pergelangan tangan (wrist) adalah sendi (joints). Sendi adalah tempat tubuh bisa menekuk. Hidung (nose) dan dagu (chin) tidak bisa menekuk.

daad727129f78ff32320.en: Your tutor checks that you drew a body and labelled three parts.
daad727129f78ff32320.id: Tutormu memeriksa apakah kamu sudah menggambar tubuh dan memberi label pada tiga bagian.

9d4e6befd00a712028a9.en: The head is at the top of the body. It has the eyes, nose, mouth and ears.
9d4e6befd00a712028a9.id: Kepala (head) ada di bagian atas tubuh. Di kepala ada mata, hidung, mulut, dan telinga.

2c95ea63a7faab7e4f46.en: The foot is at the end of the leg. We stand and walk on our feet.
2c95ea63a7faab7e4f46.id: Telapak kaki (foot) ada di ujung kaki. Kita berdiri dan berjalan dengan telapak kaki.

b5c3199747530de645e0.en: The arm is at the side of the body. We use our arms to carry, reach and wave.
b5c3199747530de645e0.id: Lengan (arm) ada di samping tubuh. Kita memakai lengan untuk membawa, meraih, dan melambai.

6eadf7d8591770d47cf3.en: The head is at the top, the arm is at the side, the leg is below the body and the foot is at the end of the leg.
6eadf7d8591770d47cf3.id: Kepala (head) ada di atas, lengan (arm) ada di samping, kaki (leg) ada di bawah tubuh, dan telapak kaki (foot) ada di ujung kaki.

062dcaf4fa8ec884236c.en: The labels are head, hand, tummy and foot. The knee is not needed.
062dcaf4fa8ec884236c.id: Label yang dipakai adalah head (kepala), hand (tangan), tummy (perut), dan foot (telapak kaki). Knee (lutut) tidak diperlukan.

4dcdd57815df0b448c5c.en: The head is at the top of the body.
4dcdd57815df0b448c5c.id: Kepala (head) ada di bagian atas tubuh.

16710cac9e0d09ed9463.en: The wrist is the bendy part between the hand and the arm.
16710cac9e0d09ed9463.id: Pergelangan tangan (wrist) adalah bagian yang bisa menekuk, di antara tangan dan lengan.

181f82c7c47b0ff4709f.en: Most people have five toes on each foot.
181f82c7c47b0ff4709f.id: Kebanyakan orang punya lima jari (toes) di setiap telapak kaki.

8e375be1d0c9462db9f1.en: The head, neck and shoulder are in the top half. The knee, foot and toe are in the bottom half.
8e375be1d0c9462db9f1.id: Kepala (head), leher (neck), dan bahu (shoulder) ada di bagian atas (top half). Lutut (knee), telapak kaki (foot), dan jari kaki (toe) ada di bagian bawah (bottom half).

4e0345ac5a524cbc5699.en: We can see our skin, hair and nose. The brain, bones and stomach are inside us.
4e0345ac5a524cbc5699.id: Kita bisa melihat kulit (skin), rambut (hair), dan hidung (nose). Otak (brain), tulang (bones), dan lambung (stomach) ada di dalam tubuh kita.

cea55136fe29518ce044.en: Eyes, nose and mouth are on the face. The elbow, knee and toe are not.
cea55136fe29518ce044.id: Mata (eyes), hidung (nose), dan mulut (mouth) ada di wajah. Siku (elbow), lutut (knee), dan jari kaki (toe) tidak ada di wajah.

ea29342026325b181911.en: We wear a hat on the head and a shoe on the foot. A glove goes on the hand and a scarf goes on the neck.
ea29342026325b181911.id: Kita memakai topi (hat) di kepala dan sepatu (shoe) di kaki. Sarung tangan (glove) dipakai di tangan dan syal (scarf) dipakai di leher.

7e5097eadfdd57051cf1.en: An arm starts at the shoulder. Then come the elbow, the wrist and the fingers.
7e5097eadfdd57051cf1.id: Lengan dimulai dari bahu (shoulder). Setelah itu ada siku (elbow), pergelangan tangan (wrist), dan jari tangan (fingers).

b931320e798f4537c270.en: A leg starts at the hip. Then come the knee, the ankle and the toes.
b931320e798f4537c270.id: Kaki dimulai dari pinggul (hip). Setelah itu ada lutut (knee), pergelangan kaki (ankle), dan jari kaki (toes).

59e5422bb6965f7f15d8.en: We walk with our legs and we hold a pencil with our hands.
59e5422bb6965f7f15d8.id: Kita berjalan dengan kaki (legs) dan memegang pensil dengan tangan (hands).

b154b6d3f21cf20bb86a.en: We have two eyes, one nose, two ears and one mouth.
b154b6d3f21cf20bb86a.id: Kita punya dua mata, satu hidung, dua telinga, dan satu mulut.

669856abaa99c1af15de.en: Kim kicks with her foot and waves with her hand.
669856abaa99c1af15de.id: Kim menendang dengan kakinya (foot) dan melambai dengan tangannya (hand).

63e5dce68956f18cb5da.en: The foot is at the bottom of the leg. We stand on our feet.
63e5dce68956f18cb5da.id: Telapak kaki (foot) ada di bagian bawah kaki. Kita berdiri dengan telapak kaki.

adafae93e29306c74e59.en: The tummy is the middle part of the body, between the chest and the legs.
adafae93e29306c74e59.id: Perut (tummy) adalah bagian tengah tubuh, di antara dada dan kaki.

9d59f6288476859e2aa5.en: A child has a head, a tummy, legs and feet. A child does not have a wing.
9d59f6288476859e2aa5.id: Anak punya kepala (head), perut (tummy), kaki (legs), dan telapak kaki (feet). Anak tidak punya sayap (wing).

20f02b61512646064d8d.en: We have ten fingers on our hands and ten toes on our feet.
20f02b61512646064d8d.id: Kita punya sepuluh jari di tangan (fingers) dan sepuluh jari di kaki (toes).

ca102ab0f963278e1795.en: A face has two eyes, one nose, one mouth and two ears.
ca102ab0f963278e1795.id: Wajah punya dua mata, satu hidung, satu mulut, dan dua telinga.

e27dea75038576b83b77.en: We use our legs to run, jump and kick.
e27dea75038576b83b77.id: Kita memakai kaki (legs) untuk berlari, melompat, dan menendang.

9996b77c3b9764867bd3.en: 5 fingers on each hand and 2 hands make 10 fingers.
9996b77c3b9764867bd3.id: 5 jari di setiap tangan dan 2 tangan menjadi 10 jari.

3710ad3eaebccdeebfa6.en: Each friend has 2 feet with 5 toes. That is 10 toes each. 2 friends have 20 toes.
3710ad3eaebccdeebfa6.id: Setiap teman punya 2 telapak kaki dengan 5 jari kaki. Jadi, masing-masing punya 10 jari kaki. 2 teman punya 20 jari kaki.

643481665d6379f4e4f1.en: Your eyes help you see the world around you.
643481665d6379f4e4f1.id: Matamu (eyes) membantumu melihat dunia di sekitarmu.

dbb7613a975a14bd7cfc.en: You walk with your legs and feet. You use your hands to hold things.
dbb7613a975a14bd7cfc.id: Kamu berjalan dengan kaki (legs) dan telapak kaki (feet). Kamu memakai tangan (hands) untuk memegang benda.

c54a17dfb1253e1b5164.en: The heart is inside your chest. It pumps blood around your body.
c54a17dfb1253e1b5164.id: Jantung (heart) ada di dalam dadamu (chest). Jantung memompa darah ke seluruh tubuhmu.

8a750d802d1e74968696.en: The elbow is a joint in the middle of your arm.
8a750d802d1e74968696.id: Siku (elbow) adalah sendi di tengah lenganmu.
